title: Jezero rim traverse: the shortest line is not the answer

destination.name: Western rim target (demo coordinate, not a gazetteer feature)

narrative: A two-person crew leaves a base at the Jezero crater reference point for a rim target ~25 km away.
The great-circle line looks shortest, but real MOLA elevations show slopes above the 15° scenario limit.
Terrain-aware and resource-conservative routes avoid them with a ~3 km detour and less climbing.
At 60% of the outbound leg a 35% battery capacity loss and 30% speed loss are simulated.
Continuing breaks the modelled reserves; RedReturn recalculates and shows the revised mission (abort and return).
